DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma with superimposed chronic bronchitis (Asthma-COPD Overlap Syndrome).

This combination of fixed obstruction from your smoking history and significant airway hyperresponsiveness confirms a dual diagnosis. We should initiate a high-dose inhaled corticosteroid combined with a long-acting bronchodilator, along with pulmonary rehabilitation. Do you have any concerns about this treatment plan or do you experience any specific triggers like cold air or allergens?
